players.name: Frankie Luvu
players.comment: Luvu recorded six tackles (two solo) and a forced fumble during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Sonny Styles
players.comment: Styles recorded 13 tackles (five solo) during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Nick Cross
players.comment: Cross finished Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants with six tackles (one solo).

players.name: Jeremy Reaves
players.comment: Reaves recorded nine tackles (seven solo), one pass defense and one fumble recovery during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Amik Robertson
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Drew Stevens
players.comment: Stevens made his only field-goal attempt and was successful on all three of his extra-point tries in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.comment: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.comment: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Treylon Burks
players.comment: Burks (foot) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Bengals.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.comment: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.comment: Okonkwo (back) returned to Thursday's eventual 24-21 win at the Giants, finishing with four catches (on eight targets) for 24 yards.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.comment: Croskey-Merritt (groin) is listed as active Monday against the Bengals.

players.name: Demetrius Knight Jr.
players.comment: Knight finished with eight tackles (six solo) and a defensed pass against the Steelers in a 38-18 victory Sunday.

players.name: Barrett Carter
players.comment: Carter posted six tackles (two solo) and a defensed pass in Sunday's 38-18 win over Pittsburgh.

players.name: Jordan Battle
players.comment: Battle finished Sunday's 38-18 win over Pittsburgh with six tackles (four solo), one defensed pass and one forced fumble.

players.name: Evan McPherson
players.comment: McPherson made one of his two field-goal attempts and all five PATs in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.

players.name: Tee Higgins
players.comment: Higgins (knee) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Dohnte Meyers
players.comment: Meyers caught both of his targets for 20 yards and a touchdown while also adding 58 yards as a kick returner during Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.

players.name: Dalton Risner
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Joe Burrow
players.comment: Burrow (illness) does not have an injury designation ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders.

players.name: Mike Gesicki
players.comment: Gesicki caught one pass for nine yards in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
